info.name: Returns a list of publications that match a given filter.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Filter by environment key, if filled.

params.name: revision
params.description: Filter assets by revision number, if filled.

params.name: assetKey
params.description: Filter by Asset key, if filled.

params.name: portfolioKey
params.description: Filter assets by portfolio key, if filled.

params.name: createdDateSince
params.description: Filter assets created from one point in time on, if filled.

params.name: createdDateTo
params.description: Filter assets created up to one point in time, if filled.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of elements that should be returned in a single page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the last page, to get the following page with the same filters applied.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort order of the elements.
-element1 for descending, element2 for ascending.
Multiple orders joined by comma.
Example -element1,element2 to sort by element1 descending then by element2 ascending
Currently supported sort values: CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, ApplicationKey, AssetKey, ApplicationName, AssetName, FinishedAt
Default sort: -CreatedAt

items.docs:
Returns a list of publications that match a given filter. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** permission for the operation.

info.name: Requests the creation of a new publication.

items.docs:
Requests the creation of a publish-operation. It returns the created publication operation.

API Client needs the **Asset management > Change** permission for the operation.

info.name: Return a publication by its operation key.

items.docs:
Returns a publication by its operation key. If the publication is not found, a 404 error is returned.

API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** permission for the operation.

info.name: Returns publication log messages for a given publication operation key.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit of elements in the page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset from previous page. Don't fill if first page.

items.docs:
Returns publication log messages for a given publication operation key. If the publication is not found, a 404 error is returned.

API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** permission for the operation.
